Package org.apache.juneau.rest.auth.oauth.flow

Class OAuthHttpPolicy

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.rest.auth.oauth.flow.OAuthHttpPolicy
public final class OAuthHttpPolicy extends Object
URL and connection policy for the HTTP calls an OAuth client makes to endpoints it did not choose itself (metadata documents, token endpoints, client-registration endpoints).

A policy instance does three things for each HTTPRequest passed to apply(HTTPRequest):

  • Checks the target URL: an absolute https URL with a host, no user info, and (unless private targets are allowed) a host that is not a loopback, private, link-local, metadata or otherwise reserved address. Numeric hosts that are not in canonical dotted-quad form, hosts with a trailing dot and *.localhost names are refused, and the host name is resolved so that a name pointing at a reserved address is refused too.
  • Disables redirect following.
  • For https requests, installs a socket factory that checks the address the connection was actually established to before any TLS data is exchanged.

Plain http is accepted only when explicitly allowed, or for loopback hosts when private targets are allowed. The connection-time address check applies to https only; for http only the resolve-time check applies. Neither check is applied when the request is routed through an explicit proxy.

Since:
10.0.0

      public static OAuthHttpPolicy of(boolean allowPrivateUrls, boolean allowInsecureHttp)
      Creates a policy.
      Parameters:
      allowPrivateUrls - true to allow loopback, private, link-local and metadata targets (and plain http to loopback hosts).
      allowInsecureHttp - true to allow plain http to any host that otherwise passes the policy.

      A new policy.
